newsitem.title: FRANCE: Broker placing 3 mln Alcatel shares - market source.
newsitem.headline: Broker placing 3 mln Alcatel shares - market source.

text.p: French brokerage Delahaye, a unit of Societe Generale, is placing three million shares in Alcatel Alsthom at 647 francs per share, market sources said on Thursday.

The seller was rumoured to be Fiat, which holds around two percent of Alcatel's capital, but a spokeswoman at Fiat France denied the company was selling Alcatel shares. "It's not Fiat who's selling," she told Reuters.
Its shares were down 4.13 percent at 650 francs at 1000 GMT.
One trader said news that Britain's GEC was bidding for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF was pressuring Alcatel shares as it was favourable for its French bidding rival Lagardere.
"GEC's involvement in the bidding means that politicians in France will look more favourably on Lagardere's offer," a trader said.
Alcatel has lined up an all-French slate of partners while Lagardere's plans have been more open to foreign partnerships.
Lagardere said on Wednesday that it was aware the British company was bidding for Thomson-CSF and that it did not regard the move as unfriendly.
